name: terraform-root
purpose: The composition root for GCP: wires ~26 child modules into one environment (one project per environment), refuses a live autonomy ceiling at plan time, and derives every trust-zone/egress rule from the catalogue rather than letting them be typed twice.
key_contracts: local.ceiling_reaches_a_venue (main.tf:102) — the one membership test on the 3 live rungs; venue_credential_readable and output live_capable both reference it
removed { from = module.cloud_run.google_cloud_run_v2_service.workload } x4 (main.tf:1004-1034) — releases the 4 Cloud Run services from Terraform state without destroying them (ADR 0036 decision 5)
output console_front_door / portal_front_door / dns_zone / live_capable / egress_proxy / trust_zones (outputs.tf:64-87,422-541)
production_evidence: Applied to the `algorik-dev` project by infra.yml's `up` action, torn down 2026-09-13 (166 resources + cluster deleted), re-applied 2026-09-20 with `0 added, 1 changed, 0 destroyed` over 238 resources but 0 Cloud Run services exist because the GitOps bootstrap dies on Argo CD's image failing the CRITICAL scan gate (infrastructure/CLAUDE.md, "Before changing anything" section). test/stage/prod tfvars all carry project_id="unprovisioned" and have never been applied.
io_and_state: Provisions GCP resources via the google/google-beta providers only; state is a GCS backend with prefix `qip/state` (main.tf:47-49). Reads 3 files at plan time with file(): data/datasets/universe.json (catalogue.tf:57) plus any of 6 optional per-workload JSON files (venue-registrations, wallet-statement, capital-fabric, central-horizons, risk-limits, source-candidates), all null in every committed tfvars.
status_reason: Structurally sound and plan-time gated (3-layer paper boundary, refuses live ceiling), but only 1 of 4 environments has ever had a real project, and that one currently serves 0 Cloud Run traffic because the GitOps control plane it depends on for service reconciliation is suspended (ADR 0093).
gaps_observed: control_fabric_topic hard-coded to null (main.tf:493) — no Pub/Sub control-fabric resource exists anywhere in this configuration; three named blockers (no client, ADR 0011 replaced Pub/Sub with in-tree HTTP mesh, no ADR yet)
execution_nodes = {} in every environment's tfvars — the whole module.execution_node for_each is empty, so 0 execution nodes are provisioned anywhere (variables.tf:245-313)
dns_zone_domain is "" in every environment as of ADR 0095 — module.dns_zone creates nothing (main.tf:1249-1285)
public_edge.hostnames is [] (default) in every environment — module.public_edge creates 0 resources (main.tf:1062-1077)

name: terraform-catalogue
purpose: The single source of truth for every Cloud Run workload's identity, plane, trust zone, env vars, secret mounts and config-file mounts; since ADR 0036 it no longer creates the Cloud Run service itself (that is a Config Connector RunService manifest under gitops/envs/<env>/), only the identity, grants and published files a manifest cannot carry.
key_contracts: local.cloud_run_catalogue = { api, fastbrain, deepbrain } (catalogue.tf:234-570) — the 3 built binaries
module "openobserve" count = vendored_openobserve_image_digest != null (catalogue.tf:796-874) — the one 'vendored' (non-built) workload
resource terraform_data "catalogue_is_placed" precondition refusing the fast brain the egress proxy (catalogue.tf:668-687)
production_evidence: 3 identities (api, fastbrain, deepbrain) plus openobserve exist in algorik-dev per infrastructure/CLAUDE.md's 2026-09-04 observation (services answered Google Frontend's internal-ingress 404, openobserve answered 308); the RunService manifests that make them serve traffic are managed by the suspended GitOps cluster.
io_and_state: Reads data/datasets/universe.json with file() (catalogue.tf:57) and hashes it into every manifest's mount path; creates no values, only empty Secret Manager grant targets and GCS objects for the published config files.
status_reason: Complete for the 3 shipped binaries out of the blueprint's ~70; no job/CronJob entries exist because none is needed yet.
gaps_observed: The fastbrain secret_mounts block deliberately omits a venue credential (catalogue.tf:465-483) — no live venue path exists from any workload

6 optional config files (venue_registrations, wallet_statement, capital_fabric, central_horizons, risk_limits, source_candidates) are all null in every environment, so every corresponding QIP_*_PATH env var is absent from every mount

name: modules/ai
purpose: Provisions somewhere for a managed Vertex AI training job to run (bucket, metadata store, endpoint) but explicitly does not make the platform able to submit one — qip_training's Vertex port has no client, credential or egress path.
key_contracts: output reachable_by_this_build (outputs.tf:18) — states the gap explicitly
production_evidence: var.enable_vertex_ai is false in every environment's tfvars — module creates 0 resources anywhere it has been applied.
io_and_state: Would create a KMS-encrypted GCS bucket and Vertex AI resources; no adapter in the Rust workspace can open them.
status_reason: Fully implemented Terraform, off by default everywhere, and paired with a documented Rust-side gap (no Vertex client/credential/egress) that infra alone cannot close.
gaps_observed: qip_training::vertex has no client, no credential and no egress path (module main.tf:1-11) — enabling this variable produces a healthy, empty, billable service with nothing that can submit to it

name: modules/backup
purpose: A disk-snapshot schedule for the execution node's journal (the one record that cannot be recomputed) and the KMS key that encrypts the snapshots; Terraform cannot attach the policy to a disk because the disk is created later by the instance group, so a runbook command output fills that gap.
production_evidence: No execution node exists in any environment (execution_nodes = {} everywhere), so the schedule has no disk to attach to; module itself is unconditional so its resources exist in dev's applied state.
io_and_state: Creates a Compute Engine snapshot schedule resource and a KMS key; no runtime I/O.
status_reason: The schedule and key are provisioned, but coverage is zero until a person runs the printed attachment command against a real node disk — and no node exists yet.
gaps_observed: No enable_backup flag by design; NOT-COVERED.md names what is excluded, including positions/open orders which the disaster-recovery runbook says are reconciled from the venue, never restored

name: modules/binaryauthorization
purpose: The whole Binary Authorization chain (asymmetric KMS key, Container Analysis note, attestor, project-wide policy with default rule REQUIRE_ATTESTATION) so only images the pipeline's attestor signed can run on Cloud Run or the GKE control-plane cluster.
key_contracts: google_kms_crypto_key.attestor (main.tf:54) — ASYMMETRIC_SIGN, the one asymmetric key in the whole platform
google_binary_authorization_policy.platform (main.tf:199) — one rule, no per-image exemptions except the vendored images path
production_evidence: Unconditional module (no count/for_each) — applied in dev; every catalogue Cloud Run service carries binary_authorization { use_default = true } evaluating this project policy (catalogue.tf comment, main.tf:756-795).
io_and_state: KMS-backed signing key (private half never leaves KMS); attestations recorded as Container Analysis occurrences by deploy.yml/vendor.yml, not by this module.
status_reason: Closes a documented prior gap (enforcement was on against the implicit ALWAYS_ALLOW policy) and is applied in the one real environment.
gaps_observed: The pipeline's own signing identity is the one weak point, named in OUT-OF-BAND.md: whoever can run a deploy.yml step can sign an image — a stronger (e.g. two-person, HSM-gated) arrangement is out of reach of this repository alone

name: modules/cicd
purpose: The pipeline's identity: a Workload Identity Federation pool scoped to exactly one GitHub repository via an attribute condition, and two service accounts (deploy, infra) impersonated by GitHub Actions with no downloaded key.
production_evidence: deploy.yml, vendor.yml, infra.yml and image.yml all authenticate through this pool in dev; infrastructure/CLAUDE.md documents actual runs (e.g. infra.yml run 52, deploy.yml run 33891084271).
io_and_state: No I/O of its own; grants short-lived Google credentials per GitHub Actions job, nothing persisted.
status_reason: Applied, exercised by every workflow run recorded in infrastructure/CLAUDE.md, and covered by acceptance tests that pin the WIF-only, no-key, no-repo-variable invariants.

name: modules/cloudrun

key_contracts: google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member.mounted / .env (main.tf:323,343) — file mounts vs. ADR 0031's vendored-only env-value exception
production_evidence: for_each over 3 catalogue workloads plus 1 openobserve instantiation, applied in dev (catalogue.tf:694-738,796-874); parity test in qip-acceptance/tests/manifest_wiring.rs holds gitops/envs/*/*.yaml to this module's outputs.
io_and_state: Publishes config files and the egress bootstrap as content-hashed GCS objects; grants Secret Manager accessor per mount; no runtime I/O itself.
status_reason: The identity/grants half is applied and working; the service half migrated to Config Connector manifests whose reconciliation is currently blocked by the suspended cluster, so the module's outputs describe services that are not presently being kept in sync by anything.
gaps_observed: collector_image_digest only becomes non-null once metrics_collector_image_digest names a mirrored digest — none does in any environment, so metrics_collected is false everywhere (main.tf:725-730)

name: modules/connectivity
purpose: Partner Interconnect VLAN attachments and Private Service Connect for a colocated cage's private path back to the VPC — the answer to prod's 3 cells (chicago-1, newyork-1, dubai-1) that sit ~300-400km from their venues with no local GCP region.
production_evidence: enable_partner_interconnect and enable_private_service_connect are both false in every environment's tfvars — 0 resources anywhere applied.
io_and_state: Would create Cloud Router BGP sessions and VLAN attachments; none exist.

gaps_observed: An attachment with no partner circuit sits PENDING_PARTNER and bills hourly once activated whether or not traffic crosses it (main.tf:154-162)

name: modules/data
purpose: The platform's 6 managed data services (BigQuery, Cloud Storage archive, AlloyDB, Bigtable, Memorystore, Spanner), each gated off by default because this build implements only 3 storage targets (memory/file/in-tree engine) and provisioning an unopenable database is a bill and an attack surface.
key_contracts: google_spanner_instance.global / google_spanner_database.positions (main.tf:326,343) — the ledger database trust-zones wires grants against
production_evidence: All 6 enable_* flags are false in every environment's tfvars — module creates 0 storage resources anywhere applied.

status_reason: Complete, gated-off Terraform matching a documented Rust-side limitation (StorageTarget::is_implemented returns true only for memory/file/engine); NOT-PROVISIONED.md is the explicit gap record.
gaps_observed: No AlloyDB/Postgres driver exists in the Rust workspace (module header, main.tf:1-19); the flag exists specifically to prevent a healthy empty billable instance from reading as a working capability

name: modules/dns-zone
purpose: The algorik.ai Cloud DNS zone and its A records, deriving each record's address from the module that reserved it (gitops-gateway or iap-edge) rather than a pasted literal, so the record cannot silently disagree with the reservation.
production_evidence: dns_zone_domain is "" in every environment as of ADR 0095 (dev's tfvars line 681 explicitly empties what was previously dev's zone) — module creates 0 resources anywhere.
io_and_state: Would create a Cloud DNS managed zone and A records; none exist. The one remaining manual step (nameserver delegation at the registrar) is now moot since the zone is unset.
status_reason: Superseded by ADR 0095 (Cloud Run's own IAP door needs no DNS at all); module is complete and heavily tested but instantiates nothing in any environment.

name: modules/egress-proxy
purpose: Publishes the one committed Envoy bootstrap (infrastructure/egress/envoy.yaml) to a GCS bucket, once per environment, for mounting as a Cloud Run sidecar or execution-node systemd unit — the only outbound HTTPS path the workspace's TLS-less HTTP client can use.
key_contracts: output sidecar (outputs.tf:1) — the composed Envoy container spec
output dialled_upstreams / endpoints (outputs.tf:21,38) — plan-time gate that the bootstrap dials only var.allowed_upstreams
production_evidence: Attached to api and deepbrain in the catalogue (egress_proxy = true, catalogue.tf:266,501) and to every execution node's startup script (main.tf:706-707); applied in dev.
io_and_state: Publishes one static file to GCS; no runtime I/O of its own. The proxy itself (Envoy) does the runtime egress.
status_reason: Closes a documented prior gap (the Kubernetes chart's Envoy Deployment was committed commented-out and never ran); applied and load-bearing for the api/deepbrain/execution-node paths.
gaps_observed: fastbrain deliberately carries no proxy (catalogue.tf precondition, catalogue.tf:682-685) — a structural guard, not a gap, but worth noting as an asymmetry

name: modules/evidence
purpose: A write-once GCS bucket backing qip_mesh::ports::EvidenceStore — locked retention policy, object versioning and uniform bucket-level access so the people who run the platform structurally cannot revise its evidence.

io_and_state: One locked, versioned, uniform-access GCS bucket, KMS-encrypted with its own key.
status_reason: Applied in dev, structurally append-only, and covered by tests proving no identity can delete.

name: modules/execution-node

key_contracts: google_compute_instance_template.node with isolcpus derived from machine_type (main.tf:305-434)
output venue_credential_bound / shadow_mode (outputs.tf:45,58) — combines ceiling + shadow_mode + secret presence

status_reason: Fully built and heavily tested module; zero nodes exist anywhere because the boot-image bake (modules/image-bake) has never been dispatched and region_allocation — deliberately never defaulted — has never been chosen by a person.
gaps_observed: No boot_image self-link exists (dev tfvars comment, environments/dev/terraform.tfvars:175-221) — the bake exists (images/execution-node/) but has never been run

name: modules/gitops-control-plane
purpose: One GKE Autopilot cluster per environment, private endpoint/nodes only, running Config Connector, Argo CD and Kargo and no trading binary — the sole reason ADR 0036 brought Kubernetes back after ADR 0024 retired the runtime cluster.
key_contracts: google_kms_crypto_key.etcd with prevent_destroy = true (main.tf:103) — the resource that blocked closing gitops_enabled
google_service_account.kcc / .argocd / .kargo (main.tf:503-517) — 3 controller identities, each to its one job
production_evidence: gitops_enabled=true in dev only (environments/dev/terraform.tfvars:138); cluster was applied, then suspended via infra.yml's `suspend` action (a targeted destroy of the cluster resource, keeping the etcd key and rest of state) because every published Argo CD image fails vendor.yml's CRITICAL gate on CVE-2025-68121 (infrastructure/CLAUDE.md).
io_and_state: GKE Autopilot cluster with etcd encrypted under a dedicated KMS key; no application state of its own.
status_reason: gitops_enabled cannot be set false without Terraform planning to destroy the prevent_destroy-protected etcd key, so the module stays declared while the cluster it describes is manually suspended out-of-band — the config and reality have diverged (ADR 0093).
gaps_observed: Cannot be cleanly turned off: closing count to 0 plans a destroy of google_kms_crypto_key.etcd which carries prevent_destroy (main.tf:103-123); ADR 0093 names moving the key out of this module as the durable fix, not yet done

name: modules/gitops-gateway
purpose: The optional public front door to the GitOps control plane — global address, managed certificate, IAP gate in front of a GKE Gateway — off in every environment, with operators instead reaching Argo CD/Kargo through the fleet Connect gateway and a port-forward.
production_evidence: gitops_gateway_enabled=false in dev (environments/dev/terraform.tfvars:521) and unset elsewhere — count=0 everywhere, 0 resources applied.
io_and_state: Would create a global HTTPS load balancer front-end; none exists.
status_reason: Fully built, deliberately off — reached instead via kubectl port-forward through the Connect gateway (dev tfvars rationale, lines 525-558).

name: modules/iap-edge

production_evidence: gitops_portal_hostname="" in dev (environments/dev/terraform.tfvars:613) — count=0, 0 resources applied. infra.yml run 71 previously failed applying this module's Cloud Armor policy on a zero project-wide quota.

gaps_observed: infra.yml run 71 failed with 'Quota SECURITY_POLICY_RULES exceeded. Limit: 0.0 globally' — a project-level Cloud Armor allowance that would need a quota increase request Google may refuse (main.tf module header, dev tfvars:583-600)

name: modules/iap-run
purpose: Identity-Aware Proxy directly on the portal's Cloud Run service (ADR 0095) — no load balancer, no reserved address, no certificate, no DNS record — the console's actual front door in every environment today.
key_contracts: google_iap_web_cloud_run_service_iam_member.console (main.tf:158) — per-service access list, empty by default
production_evidence: count=1 in dev (gitops_portal_hostname=="" && console_egress_cidr!=null, both true — main.tf:1197-1225); output console_front_door composes the URL https://qip-dev-portal-<project-number>.us-east4.run.app.
io_and_state: IAM binding only; enabling iapEnabled on the RunService itself is a separate act done by infra.yml's `apps` stage because Config Connector's RunService schema had no iapEnabled field at ADR 0036 write time.
status_reason: Applied and structurally correct (per-service, empty access list by default, mutually exclusive with iap-edge by construction); functionally incomplete until an operator runs the printed grant command to admit themselves, and until portal.yaml's TO-PIN digest is resolved by a first deploy.yml build of the portal image.
gaps_observed: iap_members = [] always — the door admits nobody until an operator runs the grant command manually (main.tf:1224, README.md)
